messages.content: Hi Michael, I'm Jon Clark, and I'm interested in your 2016 Altima. I have to flag up front that $12,600 sits above the KBB private party estimate for a car with 83,223 miles—the midpoint is closer to $11,765. Before I put a firm offer together, I need a clear picture of the mechanical history. Has the CVT transmission been serviced? Any accidents, outstanding repairs, or known issues? At this mileage I'm budgeting for immediate maintenance, so I'm looking at a number more in the $10,500–$10,800 ballpark. Let me know what the service records show and we can see if there's a deal to be made.
